explanation: Relates the concrete local count to an existing cost-ledger term. The constant search parameter is $257$, matching the finite local-search term already present in the common cost analysis.
theorem_title: The local reporting count is covered by the search envelope
theorem_formal_statement: theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingCosts.local_count_le_search (n : ℕ) : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingCosts.localCount n ≤ _root_.ThreeSum.Scales.localSearch 257 n := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
For every natural input size $n$, the exact local reporting count satisfies $$C_{\mathrm{local}}(n)\le S_{257}(n),$$ where $S_{257}$ is the prescribed local-search envelope with parameter $257$.

Relates the concrete local count to an existing cost-ledger term. This is a supporting lemma in the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
